qr.title: Linking with the QR code
steps: Unbox the controller and find the QR code on the box.
Scan it with your phone camera. The page opens in your browser.
Sign in, then choose the pot the controller should go into.
Calibrate the soil sensor once: dry in air, then wet in water.
Wait for the first reading. It shows up on the pot page within a minute.
qr.note: The code works only after your order has shipped and only once.

safety.title: Stay safe with water and heat
items: Use pots with drainage, and keep a tray under them.
Add an overflow sensor and a tank level sensor, so a pump never runs dry or floods.
Stop siphoning: lift the tube above the water line or add a siphon break, otherwise water can keep flowing after the pump stops.
Run a test watering and check the pump now and then. Greenhaus reminds you.
A heater needs a hardware thermal cutoff. Without one it can only run in notify mode.
